_meta.description: Canonical competitor registry. Agents read this before scraping to avoid redundant work and to pick up known strengths/weaknesses. Update after every scrape with anything new learned.

mailforge.name: Mailforge
mailforge.pricingHint: $2-3/mailbox/mo (headline $3 to $2 volume; ~$6 effective at 10-slot minimum on yearly; $2.42 at 200 mailboxes). 10-slot minimum. $14/yr per .com domain. SSL & Domain Masking add-on $2/domain/mo or $6/domain/yr.

knownStrengths: Lowest per-mailbox cost in market ($2.42 effective at 200-mailbox volume)
Fast setup — 5 minute hero claim
Free Automated DNS Set Up (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/custom domain tracking)
Bulk DNS Updates, Domain Transferring, Multiple Workspaces
SSL & Domain Masking paid add-on
Works With Any Sending Software (no vendor lock-in)
10k+ businesses served, 4.9 rating, 1k+ community
knownWeaknesses: Not real Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts (routes to Primeforge)
No Azure mailbox option (Infrabox unique differentiator)
Shared IP reputation
10 mailbox minimum — effective floor is ~$6/mailbox at small volumes, not the $2 headline
Warmup NOT bundled — Warmforge is a separate product at $10/slot/mo standalone (only free if you also subscribe to Salesforge sequencer)
NO domain monitoring, blacklist checking, or placement testing in the Mailforge product itself — those features belong to Warmforge (separate purchase)
Dedicated IPs sold as separate Infraforge product
No /features, /compare, /integrations, /faq, /warmup routes — site is very thin
